author: Unity
description:
Is your Unity 6 game eating too much memory? 🎮

The updated Rendering Statistics window gives you a real-time breakdown of your project's performance, so you can stop guessing and start optimizing.

In this tip, we cover what's new in the Rendering Statistics window in Unity 6, including how quick access to the Profiler and more accurate and detailed metrics can help you better identify bottlenecks and prioritize fixes.

#Unity3D #GameDev #UnityTips #UnityLearn
title: Rendering Statistics window.
